blocks.html: Mantawi Residences, RLC Residences’ newest development in Cebu, is now ready to showcase its premium condo selection with the unveiling of its new showroom at Robinsons Galleria Cebu.

Officially marking this new milestone through a ribbon-cutting ceremony are RLC Residences representatives, led by Sales Group Head Mac Dang, Cebu Sales Channel Head Doj Garcia, Brand Manager Sam Gadiane, and Senior Business Development Officer Isabelle Gutierrez. They are also joined by showroom contractor Arch. Germain Maraya-Ang from Germain Maraya-Ang Contracts Corp. along with RLC Residences Cebu Sales Directors Rhainer Legaspi, Dennies Siongo, Leoniza Aguitong, Federico Pandagani, Eugenio Arcena, and Senior Broker Managers Roxby Lovitos and Phoebe Abellana.
Located at Basement 2 of Robinsons Galleria in Cebu City, the newly-opened Mantawi Residences showroom showcases one-bedroom and two-bedroom suites with loggia equipped with premium deliverables.

“We are very proud of this milestone and equally excited to welcome our clients who wish to see and appreciate their future life at Mantawi Residences. This is a testament to our commitment to provide beautiful, well-designed condos that home and investment seekers can truly be proud of,” said RLC Residences Sales Group Head Mac Dang.

Launched in April, Mantawi Residences is a four-tower premium residential development located along the progressive stretch of Ouano Avenue in Mandaue City. The soon-to-rise property boasts spacious and future-ready one-, two-, three-bedroom, and penthouse suites with loggia, and is home to indoor and outdoor amenities spread out over 1.3 hectares of land area.
Connect with our Property Specialists today to visit the Mantawi Residences showroom, open from Monday to Sunday, 10 am - 7 pm. For more details about the development, visit rlcresidences.com.
